title: Gate-crashing Bobby Kennedy's funeral at St. Patrick's
place_text: St. Patrick's Cathedral, New York City

tellings.quote: walks up to us and he says, "Russian Orthodox representatives?" And I say, "No, Sloanic Orthodox representatives."

plain: In 1968 a young Peter Levenda, a writer the episode bills as a historian of the CIA, says he slipped uninvited into the funeral of the politician Bobby Kennedy at St. Patrick's Cathedral in New York. By his account, an official walked up and asked, "Russian Orthodox representatives?", and he answered, "No, Sloanic Orthodox representatives", which got him in among mourners such as Rose Kennedy and Jackie Onassis. Levenda tells it as his own adventure and points to a still photograph of the funeral procession.
